items.name: Backlog (remaining performance obligation) growth, Q2 2026
items.claim: Backlog, defined as remaining performance obligation (RPO), grew $13.0 B sequentially from equipment and services.
items.source_excerpt: Backlog 1 growth of $ 13.0 B sequentially from equipment and services

items.name: Gas Power equipment backlog and slot reservation agreements, Q2 2026
items.claim: Gas Power equipment backlog and slot reservation agreements grew from 100 to 116 GW; GE Vernova now anticipates reaching at least 125 GW by year-end 2026.
items.source_excerpt: Gas Power equipment backlog and slot reservation agreements grew from 100 to 116 GW; now anticipate reaching at least 125 GW by year-end 2026

items.name: Total orders, Q2 2026
items.claim: Orders of $24.2 B, up 88% organically, led by robust growth in Power and Electrification.
items.source_excerpt: Orders of $24.2 B, + 88% organically led by robust growth in Power and Electrification

notes: Gas Power slot-reservation figure (GW) recorded as value 116 with currency null since the unit is gigawatts, not a currency; the claim states the full 100->116 GW range and the 125 GW year-end target. No dollar RPO total (only the sequential change) is disclosed in this release.

changelog.change: Created. RPO growth, Gas Power equipment/slot-reservation backlog, and total orders sourced verbatim from the stored 2026-07-22 8-K earnings release (data/edgar/docs/GEV.json), no web_doc fetch needed.
